social_circle.name: Melissa Harrington

background.how_they_met: Melissa and Jennifer met in high school in Worcester and stayed close into adulthood.
background.why_close: Melissa knows Jennifer's overthinking patterns, shares her low-key social style, and is one of the first people Jennifer texts when she is anxious.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Warm and practical, usually full sentences with occasional dry jokes. She texts back thoughtfully rather than in bursts and sometimes sends bookstore photos or screenshots of events.

shared_activities: making dinner at one another's apartments
talking through anxiety and practical decisions
recent_text_topics: Checking whether Jennifer has closed her budget spreadsheet and eaten dinner during stressful evenings.
Planning coffee, Elm Park walks, and bookstore browsing around their work schedules.
Sharing local theater listings, book recommendations, and low-cost weekend ideas.
Talking through Jennifer's part-time school planning and anxiety about money.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 explicitly says Jennifer's closest friend is Melissa, whom she has known since high school, and that they get coffee, walk around Elm Park, browse bookstores, and make dinner together. Q44 says Jennifer texted Melissa during a rough week, and Melissa reminded her being overwhelmed did not mean she was failing.

social_circle.name: Linda Cuzzort

background.how_they_met: Linda is Jennifer's mother; Jennifer grew up with her in a stable Worcester household.
background.why_close: Jennifer relies on her mother for practical emotional support, especially when she is spiraling about decisions, paperwork, health, or money.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear full sentences, often with reminders and follow-up questions. She notices tone quickly and may ask if Jennifer is actually okay.

shared_activities: Sunday family dinners a couple times a month
recent_text_topics: Sunday dinner timing and whether Jennifer is coming over before Monday work.
Questions about appointment portals, insurance paperwork, scanning, and uploads.
Checking in when Jennifer sounds tense about school registration, dental bills, or rent.
Family updates about Jennifer's father, Brian, holidays, and routine errands.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Jennifer sees her parents regularly for Sunday dinner and calls her mom when spiraling about a practical decision. Q06 says her mom is emotionally closest and notices when Jennifer sounds tense. Q17 and Q35 say Jennifer helps her parents with online forms, appointment portals, and insurance paperwork. Q103 identifies her mother as a medical office administrative assistant.

social_circle.name: Brian Cuzzort

demographics.education: high school graduate with some community college coursework

background.how_they_met: Brian is Jennifer's younger brother; they grew up together in Worcester with both parents.
background.why_close: They have a teasing but reliable sibling bond and stay connected through jokes, sports, and quick updates.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Shorter, more casual texts than Jennifer, with jokes, sports commentary, memes, and occasional blunt political reactions.

recent_text_topics: Patriots or Worcester Red Sox comments while a game is on in the background.
Jokes about family conversations and older relatives getting into political debates.
Quick updates about work, career uncertainty, and family plans.
Checking whether Jennifer is coming to Sunday dinner or a birthday gathering.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Brian is Jennifer's 24-year-old younger brother and that they text a few times a week, mostly jokes, sports stuff, or quick updates. Q30 says Brian is more online and more blunt during family conversations about race and policing. Q99 confirms they grew up together in Worcester.

social_circle.name: Rachel Donahue

demographics.education: associate degree in medical office administration

background.how_they_met: A friend of a friend connected Rachel and Jennifer when Jennifer's previous lease was ending; they met for coffee to discuss schedules, cleaning, and bills before becoming roommates.
background.why_close: They are not best friends, but their daily household proximity, similar weekday routines, and respectful boundaries make Rachel one of Jennifer's most frequent practical personal contacts.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Brief, practical texts about bills, chores, guests, packages, and safety check-ins. Friendly but not emotionally elaborate.

shared_activities: coordinating chores through a fridge note
shared kitchen and living room routines
tea or brief check-ins during stressful evenings
recent_text_topics: Venmo requests for rent, utilities, shared supplies, or household items.
Heads-up texts about guests, late arrivals, packages, and parking.
Chore coordination around recycling, counters, vacuuming, and bathroom cleaning.
Rachel checking in after noticing Jennifer upset at the kitchen table.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q11 says Jennifer lives with Rachel, age 28, who works in a medical office, and that they coordinate chores through a shared fridge note and split rent and utilities evenly. Q13 says they give each other a heads-up by text about guests. Q44 says Rachel noticed Jennifer crying at the kitchen table and asked if she wanted tea. Q55 mentions shared notes and Venmo requests.

social_circle.name: Priya Shah

background.how_they_met: Priya and Jennifer met by repeatedly attending the same Saturday morning yoga class in Worcester.
background.why_close: Priya is part of Jennifer's small but meaningful weekly social circle, and their connection grew from yoga into recipe swapping and casual check-ins.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Light, upbeat, and efficient. Uses occasional emoji, sends recipe links, and texts about class times or whether anyone is going for coffee afterward.

shared_activities: talking about sourdough and home cooking
occasional farmers' market or tea after yoga
recent_text_topics: Whether Jennifer is going to Saturday yoga and if the class is crowded.
Sourdough starter updates, focaccia troubleshooting, and herb-based recipes.
Affordable community yoga options when Jennifer is trying to save money.
Casual encouragement about keeping walks and yoga on Jennifer's calendar.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Priya as one of two women from Jennifer's yoga circle who are important in her weekly life. The Q07 follow-up says the friendship formed from attending the same Saturday morning class and chatting afterward, and that Priya asked about Jennifer's sourdough starter, leading to recipe swapping. Q15 and Q31 support yoga as a recurring part of Jennifer's weekly routine.
